messages:
mira: onboarding SparcLight LoRA merge for CustNova — quick smoke eval pack uploaded (ep-20260318-sparc-01). After int4 quant we see unexpected numeric table answers drifting (amount columns). can someone sanity-check?
alex: looking now. do we have the original float16 baseline outputs for the same eval pack?
mira: yes attached in the drive link: https://redwood.internal/drive/sparc/ep-20260318-baseline.csv : the int4 mean logit shift vs float16 is ~0.08 for numeric tokens, perplexity up ~1.2. small but produces rounding errors in table cells :(
jonathan: int4 can nudge tokenization alignment if special tokens or tokenizer config differ. did you use the same tokenizer checkpoint and pad/truncation settings for the merged LoRA run?
mira: i used model-tokenizer v2.1.0 same as baseline, but the LoRA merge script we used set truncate_right=True by default. baseline eval used left-truncation. could be it.
sam: try rerunning the int4 pack with truncate_right=False and seed=42, and also enable copy-kv-cache=false for the smoke run — sometimes KV cache packing changes boundary tokens on short contexts.
ci-bot: Merge sanity check started for branch sparclight/custnova-lora
ci-bot: Tokenization delta detected: 0.0019 fraction tokens remapped. Fails preflight threshold 0.001. See /ci/logs/1768459012-tokencheck
alex: small token delta explains rounding cascades. also check that the LoRA adapter uses the same BOS/EOS normalization. sometimes LoRA authors add metadata tokens.
mira: quick command i ran:
```
python tools/run_smoke_eval.py --eval-id ep-20260318-sparc-01 \
  --model sparc-light-v1 --merge-lora sparclight-lora-v3 --quant int4 \
  --tokenizer v2.1.0 --truncate_right True --seed 7
```
jonathan: try this variant:
```
--truncate_right False --seed 42 --copy_kv_cache False
```
and diff logits with baseline using our small diff script: tools/logit_diff.py --baseline baseline.csv --new new.csv --metric mean_abs

sam: if that still shows drift, run the merge with merge_alpha=0.95 to see if lower adapter scale reduces numeric drift — could be adapter scaling interacting with quant noise.
mira: rerunning with truncate_right=False now. ETA ~3m. will post results.
mira: (3m later) rerun results: token remap dropped to 0.0002, mean_abs logit shift down to 0.012, table rounding errors mostly fixed. re-run customer smoke tests. :thumbsup: 
alex: nice. follow-up: add a quick note to the adapter onboarding checklist to assert tokenizer truncation flags match baseline evals and to run token-diff preflight. small text snippet for the checklist would help.
mira: will add. also filing a tiny CI guard to fail merges when token remap > 0.001 for eval packs that include numeric-table tasks.
sam: ack, thanks. closing loop once cust test passes.
ci-bot: Merge sanity check completed: partial-fail -> token-delta exceeded -> re-run passed after config change.
jonathan: good catch. might want to add a one-liner to the onboarding doc about seed+truncate reproducibility for quantized merges.
mira: done — PR: https://git.redwood/sparc/onboard/PR-491
alex: thanks all. moving to next on the queue.
